## Highlights

Zova 1.2.0 makes trusted extensions practical across every native distribution:
a common C plugin ABI with negotiated host services, generated-C and
high-level binding support for `.zovaext` bundles, and transactional vector
change tracking that lets an extension maintain an index consistently with the
data it follows. Storage moves to format 12 with an explicit migration, and the
experimental browser package grows from SQL and KV to objects, vectors and
graphs.

## What's changed

- Added negotiated host services to the portable plugin ABI: bounded data
  access, private SQL, scalar and streaming SQL operations, and a
  snapshot-consistent vector source-history service. Zig helpers use the same C
  layouts rather than a second ABI.
- Added transactional vector change tracking (format 12). Each vector source
  records its revisions in the same transaction as the write, so maintenance
  extensions reconcile against an exact snapshot.
- Enabled trusted `.zovaext` loading in generated-C builds on Linux, macOS and
  Windows, with explicit bundle selection at create/open in the Rust, Python, Go
  and JavaScript bindings. Opening never grants trust or loads paths from
  database metadata.
- Separated extension code compatibility from stored-data compatibility, and
  completed the plugin lifecycle with explicit cleanup and recovery paths.
- Added two reference extensions built only on the public plugin ABI: NetworKit
  PageRank over bounded graph scans, and a persistent, incrementally maintained
  USearch HNSW index. Both remain experimental references.
- Documented the extension authoring contract and added release gates that
  build, install and exercise real extension artifacts.
- Reused prepared statements for single-row vector writes.
- Moved vector change-history retirement out of the per-row tracking program
  into a guarded trigger that runs only at retirement points, lowering the
  cost of tracked vector writes.
- Fixed shared Rust handles: transactions roll back when the closure panics, and
  handle retirement is enforced under the connection lock.
- Bundled the native compiler runtime in C ABI archives and verified system
  linking, including GNU- and MSVC-matched Windows plugin archives.
- Consolidated bound-store bind/split/unbind, schema-prefixed SQL preparation,
  and batch mutation scopes into single implementations without changing
  behavior.
- Extended the experimental `zova-wasm` package with transactions, prepared
  statements, export/import of persistent databases, and object, exact-vector
  and graph helpers. It also recovers interrupted transactions when a
  persistent database is reopened.

## Compatibility

- Package and C ABI identity are `1.2.0`.
- Storage format is 12. Format-11 databases are reported as migration-required
  and left byte-identical on open; migrate them explicitly with `zova migrate`
  or the migration API in each binding. Keep a backup before migrating.
- Formats 9 and 10 retain their documented copy-forward migration path, now to
  format 12. Downgrades are unsupported.
- Existing 1.x ownership, ordering, error, and transaction guarantees remain in
  force.
- Published 1.1.0 packages do not gain generated-C or binding-level bundle
  loading retroactively.

## Installation and distribution

- Native packages use `1.2.0` across Cargo, PyPI, npm, and Go.
- Python publishes CPython 3.13 stable-ABI wheels tested on Python 3.13 and
  3.14; no Python source distribution is published.
- npm publishes `zova-js`, its native companion packages, and the experimental
  `zova-wasm` package.
- Go's module tag is `bindings/go/v1.2.0`.

## Known boundaries

Core vector search remains exact; approximate search is available only through
the experimental USearch reference extension. Notifications remain same-process
events rather than a durable queue. Extension authoring beyond the documented
common C ABI, the reference extensions, and the separate browser WASM API
remain experimental and outside the stable native 1.x compatibility commitment.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ata-sesli/zova/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0
